_comment: Cosmetic-only forme species to enable in PoTATo. The base pokedex
in upstream Showdown only contains the base species for many pokemon;
purely cosmetic recolors (Florges colors, Furfrou trims, Alcremie
flavors, Vivillon patterns, etc.) are listed in the base's
`cosmeticFormes` metadata field but have no entry of their own. The
Champions mod marks them as Illegal, so they never reach the base.
This file lists which cosmetic formes to re-introduce. The patch
for each forme by copying the base's stats/types/abilities and sets
the forme-specific id/name/forme. The format configs (m-a, m-b) list
the resulting species ids in their `species_overrides` so the base
build picks them up; the data-loader surfaces them in the search
detail's forme switcher (and hides them from the search grid via the
